paragraphs.text: Mitzy or Mitzi is a female Shivan Dragon statue that serves as Wizards of the Coast 's "Lobby Dragon."
Mitzy is an enormous crimson-and-copper-scaled dragon in a threatening attack posture. She has a carving of a pierced heart containing the word "Mom" on one of her scales.

Mitzy was created to hang in the very first Wizards of the Coast Tournament Center . She was suspended above South Reception, the office's front reception desk. When the Tournament Center closed, the statue was moved across Lind Avenue to the fourth-floor lobby of Wizards of the Coast 's corporate headquarters.
In 2019, Wizards employees were given 5th Anniversary plaques featuring art of Mitzy, created by Brian Valeza .
